headline: President Biden changed the text of an earlier executive order, Executive Order 14007, which he signed earlier in 2021.
what_it_does: This order changes the wording of Executive Order 14007. Executive Order 14007 is believed to have set up a presidential science and technology advisory council. The title alone does not say what was changed or why.
when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, September 13, 2021, but the source does not say.
